main_topics.reason: The user wanted alternatives to Humira after infliximab stopped working and questioned why another anti-TNF was being proposed.
The user described being brushed off when asking about options and wanted to take part in the treatment decision.
The user described being furious and later said they felt less angry and more in control.
The user said no one had mentioned drug-level or antibody blood tests, which became a concrete question to raise about the treatment plan.
The user asked whether requesting a second opinion through the NHS could cause problems and shared worry about how it would look.

output.summary: The user was angry that a switch from infliximab to Humira seemed decided without discussion, and wanted to understand alternatives and take part in the choice. The assistant helped identify questions about drug-level and antibody testing, other treatment classes, and a second opinion; the user said they had a plan and would book an appointment to bring their list.
